blocks.text: Carbon ke do oxides hain, carbon monoxide aur carbon dioxide. Carbon monoxide zyada tar fossil fuels ke na-mukammal jalne se paida hoti hai, 2C(s) + O2(g) se 2CO(g). Yeh bohat zehreeli gas hai jo saans lene par dam ghot deti hai: yeh khoon ke haemoglobin se oxygen se zyada mazbooti se jurti hai, oxygen ko aam saans se nikal kar; zehar ka asar zyada dabao ki oxygen de kar ulta kiya ja sakta hai. Carbon dioxide fossil fuels jalane jaisi insani sargarmiyon se kharij hone wali bunyadi greenhouse gas hai, C(s) + O2(g) se CO2(g); yeh primary greenhouse gas hai jo fiza mein garmi rokti hai, global warming ki taraf le jati hui.

blocks.caption: Carbon ke oxides
rows: haemoglobin se jurti hai, dam ghutna; zyada dabao ki oxygen se ilaj

blocks.prompt: Kaun si aam insani sargarmi hawa mein carbon monoxide ka darja barhati hai, aur CO thori miqdar mein bhi khatarnak kyun hai (MCQ V)?
blocks.explanation: Petrol se chalne wali gariyan, jin ke engines fuel na-mukammal jalate hain, aam zariya hain. CO khatarnak hai kyunke haemoglobin use oxygen se kahin zyada mazbooti se pakarta hai, to kam concentration bhi khoon ke oxygen le jane walon ko baandh kar bafton ka dam ghot deti hai.

items: Na-mukammal jalne se CO (2C + O2 se 2CO): haemoglobin se jurti hai, zehreeli; mukammal jalne se CO2: bunyadi greenhouse gas.
